sources.role: Qt/SDL configuration, input, BIOS, save and save-state implementation
official supported hosts and BIOS/save-state behavior

paths.path: <QStandardPaths::ConfigLocation>/NanoBoyAdvance/config.toml; save folder is selected in Config -> System -> Set save folder
paths.naming: TOML configuration; [input].controller_guid and [input.gba] five-int arrays are source-defined and writable as a merged fragment
Each GBA control is [keyboard, button, axis, hat, hat_direction]; axis negatives use 0x100 and hats use SDL cardinal masks. GUID selects the SDL joystick but is runtime-verified by the launch layer.

paths.path: general.save_folder when it exists and is a directory, otherwise ROM directory

paths.naming: Ten numbered <ROM stem>.01.nbss through <ROM stem>.10.nbss files
